source.title: A photoconversion model for full spectral programming and multiplexing of optogenetic systems
source.authors: Olson EJ, Tzouanas CN, Tabor JJ
source.dataset: Dataset EV2 · CcaSR measurements and analysis (MSB-13-926-s010.zip)
source.changes: Per-well rows of the *_complete.xlsx sheets were regrouped into schedules; per-well 0.1-min LED programs were re-expressed on the experiment clock. FL1 Mean values are unchanged (rounded to 0.01 MEFL). The red LED program is stored as per-minute means.

system.sensor: CcaS / CcaR two-component system (green-activated, red-deactivated), "CcaSR v2.0"
system.measurement: Flow cytometry, arithmetic mean of the gated population, calibrated to molecules of equivalent fluorescein (MEFL)
system.device: Light Plate Apparatus (24-well), one well per time point; each well runs the same program shifted so that all wells are harvested together
